window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; three verifiable new stories surfaced, and no new US federal, local US or SOUTHCOM strike items could be confirmed.

stories.headline: Colombian marines find 3 tonnes of cocaine in 102 bundles on empty land at Punta Canoas near Cartagena
stories.body: Marines on a night patrol on 27 October noticed lights on a vacant plot and found 3,054 kg of cocaine hydrochloride, which the Navy valued at over $141 million. Nobody was arrested because those present fled as troops arrived; prosecutors are investigating who owned the load and where it was headed.

stories.headline: Colombian Navy detains eight on a coastal boat near Bahía Solano carrying 304 kg of marijuana hidden among mattresses and rice sacks
stories.body: The Pacific naval force reported the stop on 27 October off Chocó, where 627 packages were concealed in the cargo, along with about 3 kg of cocaine. Seven Colombians and one Venezuelan were detained and seven phones seized.

stories.headline: Portugal's Judicial Police seize 3.7 tonnes of cocaine from a speedboat 80 nautical miles off the Algarve; one suspect dies after a collision
stories.body: The interception happened on Sunday 11 October and was announced two days later, under the code name Mare Nostrum, with help from MAOC-N, the Navy, Spain's Guardia Civil and Italy's Guardia di Finanza. The crew ignored orders to stop, a collision followed, and one of three suspects died of his injuries; two foreign nationals were arrested.
